timing_review.register_api: SKSEScaleformInterface v2 Register(name, callback) stores the callback during SKSEPlugin_Load.
timing_review.view_initialization: Hooks_Scaleform InstallHooks iterates registered callbacks and installs each object under skse.plugins.<name> before publishing the global skse object for the view.
timing_review.order: InstallHooks_Entry invokes InstallHooks before the original GFx view operation. This makes the registered object available when the view initializes its HUD script; runtime confirmation is still NOT_RUN.

limitations: Static export and source review do not prove Scaleform engine invocation, pixel layout, native resource visibility in-game, or live interaction behavior.
No proprietary SWF, exported ActionScript dump, third-party source file, or game asset is included in this repository.
